Name: Haggiah
Summary: Son of Shimea and father of Asaiah in Merari's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:30: Son of Shimea and father of Asaiah in Merari's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Haggiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
